name: Sárszentágota (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, white at the hoist and light blue at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sárszentágota (a green, red and blue shield with a church and a key, within a wreath of oak) below a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Sárszentágota arms with wreath and scroll
